name: 4da-mcp-server-mcpb-tool
description: The mcpb CLI that packs the Claude Desktop bundle, pinned with its whole tree and installed by scripts/build-mcpb.mjs with npm ci. It has its own lockfile so the package audit stays meaningful: mcpb needs zod 3, whose high advisory GHSA-mrhx-c7xc-m3w5 has no 3.x fix; here zod only validates the manifest build-mcpb.mjs writes.
